holds.reason: The official Steam screenshots are genuinely 1280 x 720. The primary development-log diagrams cannot be substituted with upscaled gameplay images.
The primary interview images are supplied as small editorial illustrations. A new independent HD documentary source for the discussed prototypes and balance-board process is still needed.
The authentic 2014 team-celebration photo is a 640 x 640 original; it is excluded rather than enlarged.
No qualified, correctly credited HD image of the original recording contributors or session is admitted in this batch.
